title: Captions of a clip move with it when a freeze moves only its track
goal: When a person freezes a frame on one track (the new default), the captions transcribed from that clip should move along with the clip, so the words stay under the person speaking. Today they stay where they were and drift out of step by the length of the freeze.
notes: Seen in freeze-frame-asks-how-long-walk picture 2 (2026-10-17): Sample Talk frozen 10s at 0:03 with This track; the Captions track cues stayed at 8s while the clip they transcribe moved to 18s, and the cue across 0:03 reads 10s out. Captions carry no link to the clip they were heard off (grep captionSource in PhotonzCore finds nothing), so HoldPush.pushHeldTime(.thisTrack) only sees layerIDs(onTracks: [the clip track]). Premiere moves captions only with sync lock; here they are the clip's own words, which a person expects to follow it.
acceptance: Freeze a talking clip for 10 s at 0:03 with Freeze every track off: every caption cue and word from that clip after 0:03 starts 10 s later, and the cue across 0:03 waits through the freeze
Music and other clips on other tracks still run on under the freeze
Captions from another clip on another track do not move
A walk shows it, with the caption drift mark gone from the clip's own captions

log.note: Review before building: a Premiere editor freezing a talking shot expects the clip's own captions to stay over the speaker (Premiere needs sync lock for that; here they are the clip's own words). Risk: a clip whose sound was taken off it keeps talking under the still, so its captions must stay with the sound, not the picture; a locked captions track never moves.

Chose to remember on the Captions layer which recording it was heard off (new saved field heardOff, written only on captions) over guessing from where cues sit, because a guess by time breaks the moment two clips overlap. Captions written before this follow the one recording the document listened to, when it listened to exactly one.

Built: HoldPush.heldWithClip = own track + captions heard off the clip (captionLayerIDs(heardOffClip:)), used by pushHeldTime(.thisTrack) and setHoldPush; rippleTime now also shifts the words after the moment inside a caption the moment falls in (so the cue across the freeze waits AND its later words land after it, in Every track too); holdDrifts skips a hold's own captions. App passes sound.id to landCaptions. New walk action captionsExpectInStepWithPicture (no drift mark, no word over its own clip's still, via captionWordsOverOwnStills).

TDD: CaptionsFollowTheirClipTests (12 tests) written first; with the HoldPush change taken out 4 of them fail (cue across 0:03 stays 2.6-4.0s, cue after it stays at 5s, drift mark on the clip's own cue), with it all pass.

Verified: freeze-frame-asks-how-long-walk green with 5 real captures; new captionsExpectInStepWithPicture step passes at 10s still (last caption 26.68s, was 16.68s), at 4s (20.68s) and after Delete (16.68s). a-held-frame-reads-as-a-still-walk and the-quiet-under-a-hold-is-a-bare-slot-walk green. Scripts/test.sh green (15000 + 1446 + 201 + 112 + 25 tests). Picture 2 checked by eye: the cue across 0:03 runs through the striped still, the second clip's captions sit under it at 18s, only Sample Music carries 10s out.

left rough (audit rough, under the bar): captions written before this build have no heardOff and follow only when the document listened to exactly one recording; rewriting captions once fixes it. The line on screen at the freeze stays up for the whole still, which is what the checklist asked.

Main was red on run 44986068360: GPU out-of-memory on the CI runner (MPS kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorOutOfMemory), not this change; second sighting, filed as ci-test-slices-stop-crashing-on-the-runner-s-gpu.

A one-track freeze now takes the clip's own captions with it: the cue across the freeze waits through the still, later words and lines land the still's length later, no drift mark on them; music and other captions run on. Captions remember the recording they were heard off. CaptionsFollowTheirClipTests (12), freeze-frame-asks-how-long-walk with new captionsExpectInStepWithPicture step green with real captures, two related freeze walks green, Scripts/test.sh green.
